title: Discount code rejected during checkout
description: A valid discount code is declined with an error message at checkout, even though the promotion is active and the customer meets all conditions.

title: Support gift cards as a payment method
description: Customers should be able to redeem a gift card balance at checkout and combine it with a bank card for the remaining amount.

title: Product images fail to load on category pages
description: On category pages many product images appear as empty frames, while the same images display normally on the product detail page.

title: Shipping cost calculated incorrectly for heavy parcels
description: Orders above 30 kg are charged the standard rate instead of the freight rate defined in the shipping table.

title: Catalogue listing response time exceeds five seconds
description: The main catalogue listing needs more than five seconds at peak hours. Profiling shows repeated price lookups for each product on the page.

title: Administrator session remains valid after sign out
description: The back office session token keeps working after the administrator signs out. Server side invalidation is required.

title: Introduce verified buyer reviews
description: Verified buyers should be able to rate a purchase and leave a short review that appears after moderation.

title: Valid promotional discount code fails at checkout payment
description: Customers report that an active promotional code is refused at the checkout payment step and no discount is applied to the order.

title: Partner API reference lacks stock endpoint details
description: The partner documentation does not describe the stock availability endpoint or its response fields.

title: Order confirmation sent before payment succeeds
description: Customers receive an order confirmation even when the payment provider later declines the transaction.

title: Allow returns to be started from the order history
description: Customers should be able to request a return online and print a prepaid label without contacting support.

title: Category page displays broken product images
description: Several category pages show broken image placeholders in place of product photos since the latest media migration.

title: Tax rounding differs between basket and invoice
description: The basket and the final invoice can differ by one cent on multi item orders because rounding is applied at different stages.

title: Add low stock notification for store managers
description: Store managers need an automatic notification when a product falls below its configured minimum quantity.

title: Search index rebuild blocks the storefront
description: The nightly search index rebuild slows all storefront requests for about twenty minutes. It should run incrementally.

title: Customer invoices accessible through predictable links
description: Invoice links use sequential numbers and can be opened without signing in. Access must be checked on the server.

title: Update the returns policy page
description: The returns policy page still describes the former 14 day period and needs to reflect the current 30 day policy.

title: Saved addresses missing after account merge
description: Customers who merge two accounts lose the addresses stored on the secondary account.

title: Display delivery estimate on the product page
description: Show the expected delivery date next to the purchase button based on the customer postcode.

title: Mobile menu closes when scrolling the category list
description: The navigation menu closes unexpectedly on phones when the visitor scrolls through a long category list.

title: Appointment reminder messages not delivered
description: Patients with a confirmed appointment do not receive the reminder message scheduled for the previous day.

title: Enable online rescheduling for booked visits
description: A booked visit should be movable to another free slot from the website up to one day in advance.

title: Doctor availability shows incorrect time slots
description: The availability view offers slots outside the working hours entered for the doctor.

title: Patient search takes over ten seconds at reception
description: Searching for a patient by surname takes more than ten seconds because the query scans the whole table.

title: Medical record downloads lack an access check
description: Record download links work for any signed in user who has the link. Access must be limited to the treating staff.

title: Patients report missing appointment reminder messages
description: Several patients say that no reminder message arrived before their appointment and they nearly missed the visit.

title: Prepare a quick start guide for reception staff
description: Reception staff need a short guide covering check-in, cancellations and the waiting list.

title: Add waiting list for fully booked days
description: Patients should be able to join a waiting list and receive an offer when a slot becomes free.

title: Insurance number validation rejects valid formats
description: Numbers with a letter prefix are rejected although insurers issue them in that format.

title: Incorrect time slots displayed in doctor availability calendar
description: The doctor availability calendar lists time slots that fall during breaks and outside the configured hours.

title: Daily schedule report slows down the whole system
description: Generating the daily schedule report locks tables for several minutes and delays all bookings at the start of the day.

title: Display expected queue duration at patient check-in
description: The check-in terminal should display the expected wait based on the current queue for each doctor.

title: Cancelled appointments still block the calendar
description: A slot stays unavailable after a cancellation until the calendar is refreshed by an administrator.

title: Patient diagnoses exposed in server logging
description: Server logging captures patient names and diagnoses from booking requests. These fields must be removed before anything is stored.

title: Document the appointment status lifecycle
description: Developers need a description of each appointment status and the allowed transitions between them.

title: Printed visit summary omits follow-up date
description: The printed summary leaves out the follow-up date even when the doctor has entered one.

title: Provide appointment confirmation in Arabic
description: Patients should receive confirmation messages in their preferred language. Arabic is the most requested option.

title: Duplicate patient records created at registration
description: Registering a returning patient with a different phone number creates a second record instead of matching the existing one.

title: Allow doctors to block time for emergencies
description: Doctors need a quick way to block part of the day so that no new appointments can be booked in that time.

title: Clinic address outdated in the patient handbook
description: The online patient handbook still lists the former clinic address and telephone hours.

title: Assignment upload fails for large files
description: Uploads above 50 MB stop with a server error and the student has to start again.

title: Add discussion forum to each course
description: Lecturers would like a simple forum per course where students can ask questions and reply to each other.

title: Final mark calculation disregards component weighting
description: The final mark uses a plain average and disregards the weighting defined in the course settings.

title: Course page loading slowly at the start of term
description: Course pages need up to twenty seconds to load in the first week of term when most students sign in.

title: Students can view unpublished exam questions
description: A direct link to the exam module shows the questions before the exam opens. The server must enforce the publication date.

title: Students unable to upload large assignment files
description: Several students report that large assignment files fail to upload shortly before the deadline.

title: Lecturer instructions needed for the marking module
description: Lecturers need step by step instructions for setting up components and publishing marks.

title: Enable calendar subscription for lecture times
description: Students should be able to subscribe to their timetable from a personal calendar application.

title: Quiz timer continues during connection loss
description: Students lose time when the connection drops because the timer does not account for the interruption.

title: Plagiarism report link opens the wrong submission
description: The report link on the grading page opens the submission of the previous student in the list.

title: Offer certificates for completed short courses
description: Students completing a short course should receive a downloadable certificate with a verification code.

title: Enrolment export omits students added late
description: The enrolment export leaves out students who joined after the first week of the course.

title: Video lectures buffer on campus network
description: Lecture videos pause repeatedly on the campus network during busy hours. Adaptive streaming would reduce the load.

title: Password reset links remain valid for too long
description: Reset links stay valid for thirty days. They should expire within one hour and work only once.

title: Student handbook describes the previous grading scale
description: The handbook section on assessment still uses the former grading scale and needs to be revised.

title: Notify students when marks are published
description: Students should receive a notification as soon as a lecturer publishes marks for an assessment.

title: Timetable shows lectures in the wrong room
description: Room changes entered by the registrar do not appear on the student timetable until the following day.

title: Attendance percentage rounds down incorrectly
description: Attendance of 74.9 percent is displayed as 74 and triggers an automatic warning to the student.

title: Allow lecturers to duplicate a course shell
description: Lecturers should be able to copy the structure of an earlier course into a new term without student data.

title: Discussion notifications arrive in large bursts
description: Forum notifications are held back and then delivered all at once several hours later.
